periocular_spatial_geometry.dominant_axis_orientation: Diagonally oriented at approximately 45 degrees downward and outward relative to the horizontal facial midline.
periocular_spatial_geometry.aspect_ratio_factor: Elongated oval with a vertical height-to-width ratio of approximately 1.6:1.
periocular_spatial_geometry.inferior_centroid_shift: Significant downward tapering with the geometric center shifted toward the superior half; the lowest point terminates in a narrow curve toward the cheek.

dorsal_band_topology.vertex_curvature_index: Shallow U-shaped curve along the posterior margin as it transitions to the white mid-torso fur.
dorsal_band_topology.normalized_band_thickness: Approximately 35% of the visible torso length from the base of the neck to the mid-abdomen.

cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.inter_bounding_box_euclidean_distance: A wide gap approximately equal to 1.5 times the horizontal width of a single ear.
cranial_pinna_bounding_metrics.apex_contour_smoothness: Convex and smoothly rounded at the superior boundary.

other_distinctive_markers: Extensive brown/yellow ferruginous staining on the ventral fur of the chest and abdomen; exposure of mandibular incisors and canines due to active mastication posture.
